phrases.latin: Nimis celeriter autoraedam agis; cursum reprime, quaesō.
phrases.english: You’re driving too fast; slow down, please.

phrases.latin: dī bene vortant quod agās! pedetemptim tamen.
phrases.english: Heaven bless what you do! But go carefully.

phrases.latin: Circitor mihi multam imposuit ob vēlōcitātem nimiam.
phrases.english: The patrolman gave me a speeding ticket.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 218.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. ticket.
